h.A maioria dos dispositivos do mercado é: Most devices on the market are just a static link stuck on a sticker — tap it, Google opens, and that's it. StarTouch is a complete platform, included with your purchase and with no monthly fee: the destination is editable at any time and you track everything in a management dashboard — your reviews, your position in the local ranking and who your competitors are. All 100% within Google's rules, in 2 mm black PS, with a quality NFC chip and a backup QR Code.
h.Vem com painel de verdade, incluso na co: It comes with a real dashboard, included with your purchase and for life, with no monthly fee. Besides taking the customer straight to the Google review, you track your reviews, your position in the local ranking and who your competitors are, measured once a week, you get the week's 1- and 2-star reviews and a weekly email report. It's reputation management, not just a sticker with a link. If you want to go further, there's StarTouch Pro, optional: the Smart Menu, where the same tap opens WhatsApp, your menu, bookings and other links, with the Google review always first. 7 days free, then R$ 19,90 per month, no commitment.

São três coisas separadas: o dispos: No. There are three separate things: you buy the device once (no subscription); the dashboard comes with it and is free — reviews, local ranking, competitors measured once a week, negative review alerts, a weekly email report and an editable link; and there's an optional subscription, StarTouch Pro (Smart Menu), for R$ 19,90 per month with 7 days free. If you never subscribe, the device and the dashboard keep working exactly the same.
h.Não precisa instalar nada. Funciona dire: No need to install anything. It works right in the phone's browser — neither you nor your customer downloads an app. NFC works on iPhone (7 and later) and practically any modern Android, and every product includes a backup QR Code for phones without NFC.
h.Sim, quando quiser. Pelo painel você tro: Yes, whenever you want. In the dashboard you can switch the destination Google Business Profile in seconds — no need to replace the device. The device is physical, but the destination is 100% editable: if you move or open a new location, the same device keeps working.
